dividend_outcome.ex_date_status_2026_08_04: RESOLVED (2026-08-04) — XD date confirmed 14 August 2026; payment 28 August 2026. Board approved the interim on 31 July 2026. Closes the sub-watch opened on 2026-08-02.
dividend_outcome.action_for_tho: Tho ALREADY holds 1,400 PTTEP shares, so no action is required to capture the dividend — simply do NOT sell before the XD date. Entitlement: 1,400 x THB 4.50 = THB 6,300 gross, paid 2026-08-28. Thai withholding tax on dividends is 10% unless he elects the tax-credit route, so expect ~THB 5,670 net. Last cum-dividend trading day is 2026-08-13; the share price typically drops by roughly the dividend (~THB 4.50, ~3% of a ~151 price) on 2026-08-14 — that drop is NOT a loss, it is the cash moving to him. This ALSO means the post-Q2 rally to ~147-151 is a poor entry to ADD into: buying before XD just buys back his own dividend at a 10% tax cost, and the Aug-04 oil de-escalation is eroding the forward earnings driver.

thesis_assessment.read: The medium-term thesis HOLDS and is reinforced on fundamentals: PTTEP is a low-cost producer with record volumes, a 20% YoY ASP lift, strong FCF, and a fresh THB 4.50 interim dividend. BUT the forward driver (oil price) has softened from the late-July ~$100 peak to ~$86 as the US-Iran risk premium partly drained, so the Q2 earnings strength is backward-looking. For a 3-month-2-year holder this is a HOLD with an attractive income profile, not a chase into post-results strength. A pullback with oil toward the Goldman ~$80 base case would be the more attractive add zone; a re-escalation snapping Brent toward $105-120 is the upside/operational-risk two-sider tracked in oil_scenario.py.

advisory_note_for_tho: PTTEP delivered a strong, clean Q2: net profit USD 833m (+104% YoY, +122% QoQ) on record ~573kboe/d volume and a $52.89/boe realised price, with H1 net income up 14% to THB 39.03bn — essentially in line with the bullish CLSA preview and beating DBS. The board declared a THB 4.50/share interim dividend payable 28 Aug 2026, a real near-term cash catalyst. Important caveat: this quarter captured the Apr-Jun Middle East risk premium, and oil has since eased to ~$86, so the result is backward-looking. This is a HOLD with good income, not a reason to add into strength; the better add zone is an oil-driven pullback. Informational, not a recommendation to trade.

oil_regime_read_2026_08_04.thesis_change: NO change to HOLD — but the case is now INCOME-led, not price-led. The THB 4.50 interim (XD Aug-14) is the reason to hold through August; the forward oil tape is working against the earnings line.
oil_regime_read_2026_08_04.do_not: Do NOT chase the post-Q2 rally to ~147-151 THB, and do NOT add before XD Aug-14 (buying back his own dividend at 10% withholding into an eroding oil tape).
oil_regime_read_2026_08_04.reassess_if: Brent breaks decisively below ~$76 (Goldman full-reopen case) -> reassess the PTTEP weight; or Iran-US talks break down and Brent snaps back above ~$95 -> the premium thesis re-firms.
